fit_reason: Whole cargo van listed by a private owner in cars by owner.
findings: Dirty, stained cargo floor with debris and grime in the rear cargo area
Scuffed, dirty interior panels on the rear doors
Faded, grayed black plastic front bumper and lower body trim
Grime and dirt on the rear step/bumper area at the cargo doors
White paint looks flat rather than glossy along the sides
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Ram Promaster. The cargo floor and rear door panels are showing a lot of grime, and the black bumper and side trim have faded to gray. We do pre-sale details that come to you, including cleaning out the cargo area, restoring the trim and clearing up the headlights. Would you like a quote?
